name: Santa Cristina de Valmadrigal (Spain)
description: White field with a red cross set towards the hoist and blue wavy stripes across the upper and lower parts.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cristina de Valmadrigal; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
